caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cabinet colored in shades of brown with visible wood grain texture. The cabinet has two main sections: the upper section features double doors with rectangular panels, and the lower section contains three rows of four drawers each, totaling twelve drawers. Each drawer on the lower section is outfitted with a small metal handle and a keyhole. The cabinet stands on short feet at each corner. The top of the cabinet is decorated with an ornate, carved wooden crest that curves and intertwines. The cabinet's structure shows framed joints and paneling on the sides. The drawing is centered on a plain, off-white background, and the name "HARRY MANN WADDELL" is written in uppercase letters below the cabinet on the right side.
title: Cabinet
